blocks.text: BAGUIO CITY—A 33-year-old man was injured after the van he was driving tipped on its side in San Carlos Heights here late Thursday night (Sept. 17). The Baguio City Fire Station said the accident occurred at 11:28 p.m. along First Road, Purok 24. Responders stabilized the Toyota Innova and helped the driver out before turning him over to the Baguio City Emergency Medical Services for medical assessment. Firefighters later returned the vehicle to an upright position. Police and emergency responders also assisted in the operation. No fatalities were reported. /apl...
